 Coram : Kishore C. Sant, J.
 Date : 14th June, 2024
 P. C.
 1.

This application is filed by the original claimants  whose reference came to be allowed by the learned reference  court under Section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act.
 3.
Heard the learned counsels for the parties.
4. Learned advocate for the applicants prays for  1 of 3  (2) 911ca5400.24

Trimbak Vetal (Died) Through Its ... vs The State Of Maharashtra, Through The ...

on 14 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/181101159/
1 withdrawal of the amount deposited by the acquiring body in this court in this appeal.

5. Learned advocate for the applicants placed on record copy of the order passed by this court dated 25-10-2023 in similar matters whereby this court had allowed the applicants to withdraw 50% of the amount of compensation alongwith accrued interest on furnishing usual undertaking to the satisfaction of the learned Registrar (Judicial) of this court.
The applicants were further allowed to withdraw 25% of the total amount on furnishing solvent surety/security to the satisfaction of the learned Registrar (Judicial) of this court.
6. Learned advocate for the acquiring body vehemently opposed the application.
7. However, considering that similar order is already passed in connected matters, this court finds it proper to allow the present application.
Hence, the following order:-
2 of 3  (3) 911ca5400.24  ORDER a] The application is partly allowed.
b] The applicants are permitted to withdraw 50% of the amount deposited with accrued interest on furnishing usual undertaking to the satisfaction of the learned Registrar (Judicial) of this court.
Further 25% amount be deposited in fixed deposit to be renewed periodically till decision of the appeal.
c] With this, application stands disposed off.
